segments.he: שָׁמַעְתִּיבְּעַצְמִי מִפִּיו הַקָּדוֹשׁ שֶׁכְּשֶׁבּוֹלְעִין הָרק הוּא מוֹעִיל לִנְקִיּוּת:
segments.en: (41.) I heard from his holy mouth that he said: "It is a great evil inclination by Torah scholars to seek to innovate novelties — meaning that each one wants specifically to innovate some new ruling."
